task.description: Resolve GitHub issue #433 (ISS-0135): std.time.nanoTimestamp missing on x86_64-macos target. Registry already had ISS-0135 OPEN from prior discovery during ISS-0134 work.

result.summary: Root cause confirmed: std.time has no timestamp API in Zig 0.16.0 (moved behind std.Io.Clock, which needs an Io instance unavailable in fillRandom()). Both call sites are in the platform-fallback branch of a PRNG seed helper, reachable only on targets without a dedicated CSPRNG path above it (e.g. macOS).
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER for fix design
